link.title: Confirm it's you
link.body: You already have a Houston account with {{email}}. We sent a code there. Enter it to add {{provider}} sign-in to that account.

refused.emailUnknown: We couldn't confirm the email for that {{provider}} account. Sign in with your email code instead.
refused.failed: We couldn't add {{provider}} sign-in. Try again, or sign in with your email code.
refused.expired: That took too long. Sign in with {{provider}} again.

identityTaken.title: Signed in with your email code
identityTaken.description: That {{provider}} account already belongs to another Houston account. Keep signing in with your email code, or ask support to join the two accounts.

referral.title: Share the love
referral.body: Our referral program is on its way. Soon, when you send a team our way and they commit to 5 or more licenses, your team will earn $250 in credits.
